animal_welfare.unit_of_concern: individual animal plus regional welfare landscape
animal_welfare.success_boundary: handoff or placement is not success without verified stable welfare outcome

mbg_public_nutrition.desired_state: safe reliable equitable nutrition service with measurable beneficiary outcome
structural_examples: new SPPG only after residual need
mbg_public_nutrition.success_boundary: meal production or delivery is not nutrition impact without outcome evidence

disaster_response.unit_of_concern: incident operational period plus affected locations, unmet humanitarian needs and currently usable capabilities
disaster_response.desired_state: life-safety stabilization, humanitarian minimum coverage, restored critical services and progressively reduced recurrence vulnerability
hard_gates: credible immediate life-safety needs before efficiency optimization
fresh verified resource and access state
disaster_response.success_boundary: dispatch or delivery is not humanitarian outcome; stabilization, service restoration, recovery and resilience require verified downstream state

non_transfer_rule: Only the evidence-transition-access/integrity-intervention-authority-outcome architecture is shared. Animal-specific welfare, ownership, capture, return, population-control and veterinary rules must never be applied to human beneficiaries. Human rights, entitlement, consent/autonomy, privacy, procurement, audit, due-process and political-accountability rules must remain inside human-domain constitutions. Disaster urgency does not suspend those rights, convert the control plane into incident command, or authorize ranking people by economic value, social status, identity, predicted productivity or aid deservingness.
